title: Glowing train
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffdd55' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffdd55' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='48' ry='38' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  
  <!-- Smoke stack -->
  <rect x='42' y='18' width='16' height='12' rx='3' fill='#ff6644'/>
  <rect x='38' y='15' width='24' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ff8833'/>
  <!-- Smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='4' fill='#ffaa55' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='7' r='3' fill='#ffcc88' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='8' r='2.5' fill='#ffcc88' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Main body -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='56' height='32' rx='5' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  <!-- Body detail stripe -->
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='56' height='5' fill='#ff9922'/>
  
  <!-- Cab (front of train, facing viewer) -->
  <rect x='30' y='34' width='40' height='24' rx='4' fill='#ffaa22'/>
  <!-- Front window -->
  <rect x='36' y='38' width='28' height='14' rx='3' fill='#335577'/>
  <!-- Window shine -->
  <rect x='38' y='40' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#88bbdd' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Headlight glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='5' fill='#ffffee'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='8' fill='#ffffaa' opacity='0.3'/>
  
  <!-- Cowcatcher / pilot -->
  <polygon points='25,62 75,62 68,72 32,72' fill='#ff7722'/>
  <!-- Cowcatcher stripes -->
  <line x1='35' y1='62' x2='38' y2='72' stroke='#ffdd44' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#ffdd44' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='62' x2='62' y2='72' stroke='#ffdd44' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='74' r='7' fill='#cc4400'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='74' r='3' fill='#ff8833'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='7' fill='#cc4400'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='3' fill='#ff8833'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='74' r='7' fill='#cc4400'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='74' r='3' fill='#ff8833'/>
  
  <!-- Rails -->
  <rect x='10' y='80' width='80' height='3' rx='1' fill='#aaaaff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='10' y='84' width='80' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8888dd' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- Glowing accent lines on body -->
  <rect x='23' y='31' width='54' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffeeaa' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
